messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2026-02-11] incident-review/INC-2026-003: Incident review INC-2026-003. The webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-08. Root cause: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
- [2025-07-09] incident-review/INC-2025-017: Incident review INC-2025-017. Auth-gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-07-06. Root cause: an expired intermediate certificate. Decision: certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.
- [2025-10-27] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Review of INC-2025-023 (the search indexer, 2025-10-24). The root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. We decided that reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2025-04-18] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Incident review INC-2025-011. Ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-13. Root cause: an index missing after the schema migration. Decision: ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2026-05-22] incident-review/INC-2026-009: Incident review INC-2026-009. The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. Root cause: two leaders elected during a network partition. Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: Team Atlas saw that the billing service's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-03-05] standup/boreal/2026-03-05: As before, billing-api needs Ledger to work.
- [2026-03-13] standup/boreal/2026-03-13: Deploy freeze for the ledger: 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 (the fiscal year close).
- [2026-01-27] standup/boreal/2026-01-27: Auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. Rationale: the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.
- [2026-02-04] standup/boreal/2026-02-04: Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Lena carries the phone until the next rotation. Boreal saw that scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-04-17] standup/cinder/2026-04-17: Observation from the Cinder team: after the runtime upgrade, the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled.
- [2026-03-17] standup/cinder/2026-03-17: Reminder: notifier is owned by team Cinder.
- [2026-05-27] standup/ember/2026-05-27: Heads-up from team Ember: notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2026-05-04] standup/boreal/2026-05-04: Team Boreal has switched to a weekly dependency update day.
- [2026-03-18] standup/boreal/2026-03-18: Reminder that the product catalog depends on the resizer.
- [2026-01-12] standup/dune/2026-01-12: The scheduler remains a the Dune team service.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10: Reminder: the authentication gateway deploys only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2026-05-28] standup/cinder/2026-05-28: Yuki Tanaka still has the Cinder pager.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2: Atlas saw that Ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it. Atlas planning meeting is every Tuesday.
- [2026-01-02] standup/boreal/2026-01-02: Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-06-08] standup/atlas/2026-06-08: Reminder from team Atlas: page Priya for anything this cycle, not Marcus.
- [2026-03-09] standup/dune/2026-03-09: Dune sits on the fourth floor.
- [2026-03-17] standup/boreal/2026-03-17: Team change: Marcus leaves Boreal and joins the Atlas team, effective today. Boreal saw that the resizer's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-01-14] standup/dune/2026-01-14: Reminder: Tomasz is on call for team Dune this cycle.
- [2026-03-17] standup/boreal/2026-03-17-2: Reminder: the event-bus deploys only on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.
- [2026-03-25] handover/2026-03-25-billing-api: The billing API has a new home: team Dune. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2026-06-03] standup/dune/2026-06-03: Reminder from team Dune: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Farah.
